assumptions.statement: Official boundary, key-area polygons, regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, heritage controls and engineering constraints are not publicly available in the site package.
assumptions.impact: The design is reviewable as an AI concept package and intake artifact; statutory controls and professional engineering conclusions remain pending.

assumptions.statement: All site and key-area geometry uses the repository maintainer-defined provisional rough polygons.
assumptions.impact: All geometry-derived metrics are design-model outputs; replace and recalculate when official or cleared polygons arrive.

assumptions.statement: Building footprints and retain/retrofit/new-build treatments are review units, not parcel, ownership or demolition conclusions.
assumptions.impact: A professional team must verify existing conditions, ownership, fire safety, heritage and implementation feasibility.

assumptions.statement: No official heritage protection or construction-control geometry is claimed by this package.
assumptions.impact: Every public-space, signage and spatial-story proposal near the heritage park requires heritage authority and professional review.

assumptions.statement: Scenario concepts use public information, manual observation and authorized feedback only; no individual-level data, face recognition or hidden tracking is proposed.
assumptions.impact: Data minimization, consent, retention limits and human review must be specified before any pilot.

assumptions.statement: Annual events, open calls, scenario pilots and service desks are reference operating mechanisms, not confirmed schedules, funding or government commitments.
assumptions.impact: Operators, safety teams, accessibility reviewers and public participation procedures must be appointed before implementation.
